snippet.title: A Day In The Lie Trailer
snippet.description:
A Day In The Lie is a short story about a serial killer. The work aims to challenge the relationship between player and protagonist. You can download the game here:

https://jordanb.itch.io/a-day-in-the-lie
and here:
https://gamejolt.com/games/adayinthelie/322602

Voiced by Brian Samuels
Created by Jordan Browne
